name: Divine Magic
body:
You have mastered one of the spells gifted to your by your god, until its use is like second nature.

Prerequisite(s): Domains class feature, 7th-level Cleric

Benefit: Choose one of your 1st-level domain spells to gain as a spell-like ability. You can then use this ability just as if you were casting the spell a number of times a day equal to 3 + your Wisdom bonus. You can still memorize the spell as normal and retain your 1st-level domain slot.

Special: You may take this feat twice, once for each of your two 1st-level domain spells.
